title: Member Spend Goodwill on Double-Charged Payments: Finch Circle Qualifying Spend Bands for Merchandise Purchases
content:
On a refund of a second capture of a Merchandise Purchases unit's payment, a member whose Finch Circle qualifying spend posted in the twelve calendar months before the request date (purchase earn entries whose posting date falls less than twelve whole months before it) reaches the upper member spend threshold of $1200.00 receives the upper member spend goodwill of $10.00; one whose such spend reaches the middle member spend threshold of $500.00 but not the upper receives the middle member spend goodwill of $5.00.

## Basis Q&A

**Which entries make up the spend?** The purchase earn entries in the member's Finch Circle Loyalty Program points ledger, by their qualifying amount, posted less than twelve whole months before the request date.

**Spend of $1200.00?** $10.00. **Of $1199.99?** $5.00.

**Spend of $500.00?** $5.00. **Of $499.99?** Neither threshold is reached; the customer is outside this rule.
